title: Uniform distribution on a subset layer
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $k$ be an integer from $0$ through $n$. Choosing a uniformly random permutation of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and taking the elements whose images are less than $k$ gives the uniform distribution on the $k$-element subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$.
